en: Changed `/recap` to decline with a short notice when it arrives relayed from a chat thread (your own included) or from a routine or webhook; typed in the terminal, the Claude apps, Remote Control, `-p` or an SDK host, it runs as before
zh: 变更 `/recap`：当它从聊天线程（包括你自己的线程）、例程或 webhook 转发而来时，改为以简短提示拒绝；在终端、Claude 应用、远程控制、`-p` 或 SDK 宿主中直接输入时，行为与之前一致
